description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide two storey detached dwelling with habitable roofspace; parking; landscaping (part retrospective)
decision_conditions: <p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, the applicant shall submit to the Council for approval in writing a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) focusing on biodiversity and wildlife which will provide full details of measures and timings, including method statements, drawings and specifications required in support of the following criteria which will need to be implemented in order to:</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">a.safeguard features of ecological importance, including areas of semi-natural habitat, protected and priority</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">species known or likely to use the site and its features for foraging, shelter, reproduction, commuting or other purposes, and the features of value to these species;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">b.avoid impacts on habitats in areas adjoining the development site, and at its boundaries in particular;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">c.ensure that contractors and those responsible for overseeing the development will implement necessary measures in full.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">d.A clear supervision / monitoring program to ensure all contractors and those overseeing the development</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">fully implement the approved measures. To be overseen by an ecologist to supervise sensitive activities and monitor compliance throughout demolition and construction.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">The construction works shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved CEMP, in order to safeguard features of ecological importance, including areas of semi-natural habitat, protected and priority species known or likely to use the site and features for foraging, shelter, reproduction, commuting or other purposes, on which they wholly or partly depend.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">REASON: To protect natural capital and features of nature conservation importance in accordance with statutory requirements, current best practice, policy G13 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041) and the objectives of the Harrow Biodiversity Action Plan.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, details for the attenuation, storage and disposal of surface water to be provided on site shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the works so agreed and the works shall thereafter be retained.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan">REASON: To ensure that the development incorporates sustainable drainage systems and achieves greenfield run-off rates, and to ensure the separation of surface and foul water systems, in accordance with Policy CN3 and CN4 Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<div>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of a cycle store system and their</div><div>dimensions shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development</div><div>shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall be thereafter retained.</div><div><br></div><div>REASON: To ensure the satisfactory provision of safe cycle storage facilities, to provide facilities for all the</div><div>users of the site and in the interests of highway safety and sustainable transport, in accordance with Policy T5</div><div>of The London Plan (2021) and Policy M1 and M2 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).</div>

<div>The development hereby permitted shall be undertaken in accordance with the Tree Protection Plan OS 2293-21.1 and Arboriculture Impact Assessment OS 2293-21 Doc 1 subject to the pre-arranged tree protection monitoring and site supervision as detailed in the report by the appointed Arboricultural consultant, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.</div><div><br></div><div>REASON: To protect the trees of amenity value and to safeguard the appearance of the locality, in</div><div>accordance with policy GI3 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).</div>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:widow-orphan"><font face="Arial, sans-serif">Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, full details of the permeable paving construction and&nbsp;</font><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">details relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. <div>All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the</div><div>first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the</div><div>development, whichever is the sooner. <div>Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there</div><div>has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.</div><div><br></div><div>Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedules of plants, noting</div><div>species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.</div><div><br></div><div>Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments including walls, fences and gates</div><div>(materials, scale of boundary, location), retaining walls (materials, location, height) and details of hard</div><div>surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site.</div><div><br></div><div>REASON: To safeguard the appearance and character of the area, and to enhance the appearance of the</div><div>development, in compliance with policies GR1 and GI4 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).</div>
